title: Agent Command Center
tagline: Command dashboard for AI agents with ephemeral DeFi wallets, monitoring, and strict control.
description: A unified command dashboard that creates isolated, ephemeral DeFi wallets for AI agents, enabling secure autonomous actions while minimizing risk exposure. Each agent runs within controlled limits—budgets, permissions, and protocols—backed by real-time monitoring and full audit logs. Even if one wallet is compromised, the blast radius stays contained.
how_its_made:
This dashboard is built with a modern full-stack architecture focused on secure, controlled, and auditable agent execution. The frontend uses Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, and TypeScript to deliver a streamlined command center for configuring policies, monitoring activity, and managing agent-specific wallets. On the backend, Next.js API Routes provide the serverless logic for authentication, policy CRUD, and the firewall that validates every agent intent before it reaches the blockchain. NextAuth.js handles CDP-based authentication, while Prisma ORM and SQLite manage policies, agent logs, and metadata with type-safe reliability.

Blockchain activity is powered by the Coinbase Developer Platform (CDP) SDK, enabling ephemeral wallet creation, balance checks, swaps, and funding. Each AI agent receives its own isolated virtual account with enforced permissions and budgets. x402 is fully integrated, providing granular access management that determines exactly which actions an agent is allowed to perform. Combined with TypeScript, Prisma Studio, and ESLint for development quality, the result is a secure and scalable command dashboard for managing autonomous DeFi agents with full visibility and control.
